steps.instruction: Let the glazes set up until touch-dry so accents sit on top instead of sinking in.
Place the highlights last and thickest — small, opaque, slightly warm or cool of pure white, never pure white everywhere.
Sharpen at most a handful of edges — the ones that hold the focal point. Count them; if it is more than five, you are outlining, not finishing.
Restate the single darkest accent if the glazing lightened it. One touch, done.
Walk away for a day, then look in a mirror or a phone photo. Fix only what still jumps out — then sign it and stop.
